# Snooze Mattress + Wellness — McAllen, TX

> Locally owned mattress store at 7913 N 10th St, Suite 130, McAllen, TX 78504, serving McAllen, Edinburg, Mission and Pharr. Shoppers get a free, about five-minute in-store Dream Mapping fitting: a sensor bed reads their pressure points and recommends the mattresses that fit their body. The store carries the major mattress brands plus the Snooze-O-Pedic line, which is sold only at Snooze, along with adjustable bases, pillows, protectors, sheets, massage chairs and the Zcliner sleep recliner. Financing is available through Synchrony and Wells Fargo, and Snap Finance offers lease-to-own. The site is available in English and Spanish (/es).

Key facts:
- Phone: (956) 586-5646
- Hours: Mon–Sat 10 AM–7 PM, Sun 12–6 PM
- Appointments: walk-ins welcome; book a free Dream Mapping fitting at https://mcallen.snoozemattresscompany.com/booking
- Delivery: we deliver and set up your new mattress, free on orders over $999, and haul away your old mattress if you no longer need it
- Sleep Coaches are not on commission
- Brands: Tempur-Pedic, Sealy, Stearns & Foster, Serta, Beautyrest, Helix, Brooklyn Bedding, FLOWT by King Koil, Snooze Handcrafted by King Koil, Copper by Spring Air, Snooze-O-Pedic (sold only at Snooze), BedTech, BedGear, Sleeptone, DreamFit
